question_text: A 7-year-old boy is brought to the physician with a 2-day history of fever, chills, malaise, and a sore throat. He has otherwise been healthy and development is normal for his age. He takes no medications. His immunizations are up-to-date. His temperature is 38.4°C (101.4°F), pulse is 84/min, respirations are 16/min, and blood pressure is 121/71 mm Hg. Pulse oximetry shows an oxygen saturation of 100% on room air. Examination shows discrete 1–2-mm papulovesicular lesions on the posterior oropharynx and general erythema of the tonsils bilaterally. Which of the following conditions is most likely associated with the cause of this patient's findings?
